# HEN COMMERCIAL ANALYTICS — MORNING BRIEF
## Friday, 2026-09-25 | ERCOT BESS Fleet (32 Nodes)

---

## 1. PERFORMANCE SUMMARY

Yesterday's fleet posted a RT average of **$36.37/MWh** — a meaningful step down from the **$69.83/MWh** spike on 09-22 and modestly below the **$39.42/MWh** on 09-23, signaling a market returning toward base conditions after a brief volatility event. Spike activity contracted sharply from 32 nodes on 09-22 to just **2 nodes today (CISC_RN and RUSSEKST_RN at >$100/MWh)**, confirming the fleet-wide RT premium environment has largely dissipated. **MV_VALV4_RN** was the standout DA performer with a DA premium of **$74.18/MWh over RT** — assets committed in DA at that node captured exceptional value. Conversely, **LFSTH_RN and DIBOL_RN** saw RT exceed DA by **$1.05 and $0.98/MWh** respectively — marginal RT outperformance, but commercially immaterial given the spread magnitude. **CATARINA_B1** recorded negative RT prices, creating a strategic charging opportunity for any RT-dispatched assets at that node; its MCC benefit of **+$32.39/MWh** partially offset the price drag.

---

## 2. DISPATCH STRATEGY BY NODE

**🔵 LEAN DA — Commit in Day-Ahead (29 nodes)**

The 5-day Sharpe analysis is uniformly LEAN DA across the vast majority of the fleet, with the highest-confidence cluster — **GOMZ_RN, SADLBACK_RN, FAULKNER_RN, COYOTSPR_RN, SANDLAKE_RN, CEDRVALE_RN, SBEAN_BESS, RTLSNAKE_BT, LONESTAR_RN, JDKNS_RN** — all carrying Sharpe ratios of **+0.49–0.50**, avg DART of **~$10.50–10.55/MWh**, and negative MCC exposure (congestion costs of **-$13 to -$16/MWh**) that are already priced into the DA signal. These nodes show tight return distributions (stdev ~$21/MWh) relative to the DA premium earned, making DA commitment the low-variance, high-confidence play. **GRDNE_ESR_RN** (Sharpe +0.490, avg DART +$10.75) and **WLTC_ESR_RN** (Sharpe +0.481, avg DART +$8.69, MCC **-$23.64/MWh**) are also DA-favored but carry heavier congestion cost burdens — confirm DA offers fully reflect MCC drag before submission. **OLNEYTN_RN** is a notable exception within the LEAN DA bucket: Sharpe of +0.364 with a **+$69.27/MWh MCC benefit** — this congestion tailwind is substantial and should be factored into DA offer pricing, as the node's true realized value exceeds the headline DART; DA commitment remains appropriate but price aggressively. **MNWL_BESS_RN** (MCC **+$12.38/MWh**) and **HAMI_BESS_RN** (MCC **+$20.94/MWh**) carry positive congestion benefits within the LEAN DA signal — both are high-quality DA candidates where congestion enhances, rather than erodes, the DA premium capture.

**⚪ NEUTRAL — Monitor Closely (FALFUR_RN, MV_VALV4_RN, RUSSEKST_RN)**

These three nodes sit in the neutral Sharpe band with no clear directional edge on a 5-day rolling basis, but each has a distinct risk profile today. **MV_VALV4_RN** posted the fleet's largest DA premium yesterday ($74.18/MWh DA over RT) but carries an MCC cost of **-$33.99/MWh** and a neutral Sharpe — yesterday's DA outperformance may be idiosyncratic rather than structural. **FALFUR_RN** logged a strong DA premium of **$37.37/MWh** but faces the fleet's second-largest congestion cost at **-$40.68/MWh** — the DA premium and MCC cost are nearly offsetting, creating genuine uncertainty about net dispatch value. **RUSSEKST_RN** spiked above $100/MWh RT yesterday and carries an MCC benefit of **+$38.04/MWh**, but its neutral Sharpe and high DART volatility make it a tactical RT monitoring candidate — watch for RT conditions similar to 09-22 before committing aggressively in DA.

**Week Ahead (09-26 through 10-01):** Abilene and Wichita Falls accelerate to **95–98°F through 09-28**, extending the late-summer demand pulse and creating favorable conditions for RT price elevation in Central Texas nodes. A **significant precipitation pattern develops 09-29 through 10-01** across virtually all regions (Lubbock 75–87%, Midland 63–71%, DFW 39–67%, San Antonio 30–59%, Houston 34–64%), signaling a potential cool front with material load reduction and wind/solar variability — model this as a **step-down in RT prices post-09-29**. West Texas wind uncertainty from the 09-25 Lubbock precip event may cause brief RT spikes at nodes exposed to PALOUS_WOLFCA1_1 — watch RUSSEKST_RN and HOLCOMB_RN1 in the HE12–HE14 window. **Strategic takeaway:** DA-lock the portfolio aggressively for 09-26 through 09-28 (heat extension supports DA premium); reassess RT exposure heading into the 09-29 front where RT price compression and renewable variability create a more complex dispatch environment.
